question: your support people keep ringing our old landline which we got rid of. where do i update the number you have for us

articles.title: Change your client contact number
articles.body:
Your **Client contact number** is the number Harbour CRM support and billing use to reach you.

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Replace the number in **Client contact number**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

answer:
Update your client contact number, which is the number Harbour CRM support and billing use to reach you:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Replace the number in **Client contact number**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.
